game.name: Wii Sports Resort
game.rules:
**Wii Sports Resort General Rules**

Reset timing can be used (starting time from pressing "Restart" instead of the regular start time) with a 3.00 second time penalty. This is the preferred method to start a speedrun.

For some sports, there are time penalties for starting from Main Menu:

- A 1s penalty will be added to runs that start from main menu and with: Duel, Speed Slice, Archery, Pickup Game, Table Tennis - Match, Return Challenge, Bowling, 100-Pin, Spin Control, Canoeing (non-igt speedruns), or Cycling (non-igt speedruns).
- A 1.25s penalty will be added to Swordplay Showdown runs that start from the main menu.
- A 0.75s penalty will be added to Wakeboarding runs that start from the main menu.
- A 1.5s penalty will be added to Skydiving runs that start from the main menu.

Unless explicitly stated otherwise, all runs must be played using only 1 controller by 1 player.

Unless explicitly stated otherwise, all runs are timed with Real Time.

All versions of the game (including the Combo Disc that also includes Wii Sports) are allowed.

**Wii Sports Resort Video Rules**

All runs in every category requires video proof. It must be acceptable video proof. The game feed has to be clearly visible (not obstructed heavily). Heavy amounts of issues with frame rate, bit rate, audio etc. could result in your run being rejected.

Game audio is not required but heavily recommended to further validate your run.

Video proof can be recorded via a Capture Card, Phone Camera, Webcam, etc. as long as they follow the other video guidelines.

Video proof can be uploaded and sent through any site (YouTube, Twitch, Google Drive, etc.), as long as the video is easily accessible.

**Wii Sports Resort Hardware Rules**

You must run on a Wii, Wii Mini, or Wii U console, using an official Wii Sports Resort disc or the Wii Sports + Wii Sports Resort Bundle disc. Doing a speedrun on anything else is not allowed (Emulators, USB Loaders, etc.)

You can only play with a Wii Remote/Wii Remote Plus Controller and a Nunchuk. Third party controllers can be used if they have no added features compared to a traditional Wii Remote. Wii Remote Accessories that have no effect on the controller's functionality can be used as well.

categories.name: [WSL] All Categories
categories.rules:
**View the "Game Rules" tab above for rules regarding Video, Hardware, and other General Rules.**

**All Categories Objective:**

-Win a match of Swordplay: Duel                                   
-Win a match of Swordplay: Speed Slice                                   
-Finish a level of Swordplay: Showdown (Any stage)                                   
-Finish a level of Wakeboarding (Any difficulty)                                   
-Finish a round of Frisbee Dog                                   
-Finish a three hole course of Frisbee Golf (Any course)                                    
-Finish a set of stages of Archery                                   
-Finish a 3-Point Contest in Basketball                                   
-Win a game of Basketball: Pick Up Game                                   
-Win a game of Table Tennis: Match                                    
-Finish a game of Table Tennis: Return Challenge                                   
-Finish a three hole course of Golf (Any course)                                    
-Finish a standard game of Bowling                                   
-Finish a 100-pin game of Bowling                                   
-Finish a game of Spin Control in Bowling                                   
-Finish a course of Power Cruising (Any Course)                                   
-Finish a stage of Canoeing (Any Difficulty)                                   
-Finish a race of Cycling (Any Stage)                                   
-Finish a five minute segment in Air Sports: Island Flyover (Any time of day)                                   
-Finish a dive in Air Sports: Skydiving      

(Power Cruising VS, Canoeing VS, Cycling VS and Air Sports: Dogfight aren't included due to being 2 player only sports)                              

**General Rules:**

Timing begins on the last A press before loading into your first sport (Example: Pressing OK to choose your Mii in Swordplay: Duel or Pressing "Resort A" to enter Frisbee Golf)                                   
Timing ends when the picture is taken during Air Sports Dive.                                   

You do not need to do any of the sports in a specific order, however you must end with Air Sports: Skydiving.

For a list of when you can exit from a sport, please see this fourm post. Exiting earlier than listed here will result in your run being rejected. https://www.speedrun.com/wsr/thread/0equp/1#gvg2j

Set the timer to 3 seconds if you decide to restart a sport and start from there

**Video Proof Requirement:**

For WSL categories, all runs require video. 



This is for the Wii Series League and therefore a temporary category on the boards. To find out more about WSL, check out https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=njWav2HFN0M. 10 Point Barrier is 35 minutes.

categories.name: [WSL] All Golf Tour
categories.rules:
This is a temporary category for the Wii Series League. More information on the rules can be found at: https://wiiseriesspeedrunning.info/wii-series-league/ruleset/

Complete the following in no specific order: All the 3 Hole Courses (Including Special), all the 9 Hole Courses, and an 18 Hole Course in Golf. 

Timing starts when you select a course, or by using restart timing. Timing ends when the ball goes in the last hole of the final course, or when "Give Up" appears.

10 Points Barrier: 43:00

Important Note - By submitting to this category you participate in the Wii Series League and agree that your public SRC account information will be published on wiiseriesspeedrunning.info.

categories.name: [WSO] A Few Stamps
categories.rules:
Collect 12 stamps in total, one in each sport, one in swordplay, one in bowling etc.

Timing begins on the last A press before loading into your first sport (Example: Pressing OK to choose your Mii in Swordplay: Duel or Pressing "Resort A" to enter Frisbee Golf) Timing ends when the 12th Stamp appears on screen.

You must use a fresh mii.

Setting up your mii beforehand with what hand it uses for certain sports is allowed.

You are allowed to collect multiple stamps in a sport, but at least one stamp has to be collected in each of them.

categories.name: All Categories
categories.rules:
**View the "Game Rules" tab above for rules regarding Video, Hardware, and other General Rules.**

**All Categories Objectives:**

To complete a run in this category, you must:

- Win a match of Swordplay: Duel
- Win a match of Swordplay: Speed Slice
- Win a level of Swordplay: Showdown (Any stage)
- Finish a level of Wakeboarding (Any difficulty)
- Finish a round of Frisbee Dog
- Finish a three hole course of Frisbee Golf (Any course)
- Finish a set of stages of Archery
- Finish a 3-Point Contest in Basketball
- Win a game of Basketball: Pick Up Game
- Win a game of Table Tennis: Match
- Finish a game of Table Tennis: Return Challenge
- Finish a three hole course of Golf (Any course)
- Finish a standard game of Bowling
- Finish a 100-pin game of Bowling
- Finish a game of Spin Control in Bowling
- Finish a course of Power Cruising (Any Course)
- Finish a stage of Canoeing (Any Difficulty)
- Finish a race of Cycling (Any Stage)
- Finish a five minute segment in Air Sports: Island Flyover (Any time of day)
- Finish a dive in Air Sports: Skydiving

(Power Cruising VS, Canoeing VS, Cycling VS and Air Sports: Dogfight aren't included due to being 2 player only sports)

**Exit Rules:**

You can exit out of the sport you are playing as soon as these requirements are met:

- Swordplay: Duel - You can exit when the feet of the opponent mii are no longer in the ground (as a result of them being knocked out) in the final round
- Swordplay: Speed Slice - You can exit when the "Finish" text appears
- Swordplay: Showdown - You can exit when the score reaches 100%
- Wakeboarding - You can exit when the clock reaches 0:00
- Frisbee: Frisbee Golf - You can exit when the goal area disappears in the final hole as a result of the frisbee entering it
- Frisbee: Frisbee Dog - You can exit when the white speech bubble in the ground appears after the final throw
- Archery - You can exit when the "Miss" (or any of the point related ones like "+10") text appears after the final shot
- Basketball: 3-Point Contest - You can exit when the final ball leaves your mii's hands
- Basketball: Pickup Game - You can exit when the timer reaches 0.0. If the opponents are about to shoot, and them scoring would hand them the win, you need to wait until that throw either hits the ground or goes in the basket before exiting
- Table Tennis: Match - You can exit when the "2 Bounces" textbox appears in the final point of the game
- Table Tennis: Return Challenge - You can exit when the "2 Bounces", "No bounce", or "Net" textbox appears
- Golf - You can exit when the ball is no longer visible as it enters the final hole
- Bowling: Standard Game - You can exit when the "[X] Pins" text appears after the final throw
- Bowling: 100-Pin - You can exit when the "[X] Pins" text appears after the final throw
- Bowling: Spin Control - You can exit when the "[X] Pins" text appears after the final throw
- Power Cruising - You can exit when the "Finish" text appears
- Canoeing - You can exit when the yardage counter reaches its goal value (if the goal distance is 100yd, the goal value would be 100.00yd)
- Cycling - You can exit when the Vincenzo text congratulating you for finishing the race appears
- Skydiving - Time ends when the screen flashes white as a result of the final photo being taken
- Island Flyover - You can exit when the clock reaches 0:00

Exiting before any of these conditions are met will result in your run being rejected.

**General Rules:**

Timing begins on the last A press before loading into your first sport (Example: Pressing OK to choose your Mii in Swordplay: Duel or Pressing "Resort A" to enter Frisbee Golf).

Timing ends when the screen flashes white as a result of the final photo being taken after forming up in Skydiving.

You do not need to do any of the sports in a specific order, however you must end with Air Sports: Skydiving.

Set the timer to 3 seconds if you decide to restart a sport and start from there. Menu timings rules found in the "Game Rules" section apply.

**View the "Game Rules" tab above for rules regarding Video, Hardware, and other General Rules.**

**All Pro Class Objective:**

Achieve Pro Class (1000xp) in every single sport.

**General Rules:**

Timing starts on the last A press before loading into your first sport (Example: Pressing OK to choose your Mii in Swordplay: Duel or Pressing "Resort A" to enter Frisbee Golf)

Timing ends when the "Pro in every sport! Congratulations!" popup appears on screen.

categories.name: All Stamps
categories.rules:
**View the "Game Rules" tab above for rules regarding Video, Hardware, and other General Rules.**

**All Stamps Objective:**

Collect all 100 Stamps across every single sport.

**General Rules:**

Timing begins on the last A press before loading into your first sport (Example: Pressing OK to choose your mii in Swordplay: Duel or Pressing "Resort A" to enter Frisbee Golf)

Timing ends when the last (100th) Stamp appears on screen.

You must use a Fresh mii. You are allowed to use 2 or more miis, but they all must be fresh. You should only use different miis in your speedrun if, by accident, you picked a mii that was not fresh in one of the sports.

Individual Level rules still apply. As such, only in Canoeing, you are allowed to play in multiplayer (2p, 3p or 4p). This does not mean other people can play with you: you must control all the miis at the same time. The main mii (the one you have used throughout the speedrun) must naturally be fresh, but the additional miis are not required to be fresh miis. This means you can progress up to the final yardage in every difficulty with the additional miis before the attempt begins.

When you finish a run, you must go through all the sports with the mii (or miis) you used to verify that all 100 stamps have been gotten during the speedrun.

**Breaks:**

To initiate a break, you must pause the game via the home menu (so the game is completely suspended). The timer of your choice (LiveSplit, FramePerfect, a stopwatch, etc.) must be paused. The video recording cannot be cut. They can be done at any time.

You will start with 30 minutes in your “break pool” and will gain more breaks as the run progresses:

- At 3 hours of gameplay: +30 minutes; 1 hour total.
- At 6 hours of gameplay: +30 minutes; 1.5 hours total.
- At 9 hours of gameplay: +30 minutes; 2 hours total.

…etc

You can use time from your break pool as you see fit. This means you can take a break whenever you want, for as long as you want, as long as you don’t exceed your current break pool. For example, if you took a 10 minute break an hour in, you cannot take a 30 minute break until you reach 3 hours of gameplay as your current break pool would be 20 minutes. Once you play for 3 hours, you will gain 30 more minutes and you would be able to take a 30 minute break.

At 12 hours of gameplay (measured by the timer of your choice), you will gain a sleep break of 9 hours. These work as normal breaks, but are long enough to allow you to sleep and we highly encourage you only use them for this purpose.
Additional sleep breaks are gained for each additional 12 hours of gameplay

If you take a break, it is very strongly encouraged you take note of its duration, its start time and ending time, and include it in your run description. Mods are not required to search for unlisted breaks.

categories.name: Golf
categories.rules:
### **View the "Game Rules" tab above for rules regarding Video, Hardware, and other General Rules.**

### **Golf Objective:**

Complete the specified Golf Course, no other restrictions.

### **General Rules:**

Timing starts when you select the specified course, either by pressing "Restart" or by selecting it from the Golf menu.

Timing ends when the ball goes in the hole or "Give Up" appears on the last hole.

**21 Holes Specific Rules:** 

Finish an 18 Hole course and finish the 3 Hole Special course in any order.

Timing starts when selecting the first course, and ends when the ball goes in the hole or "Give Up" appears on the last hole of the last course. Time spent on menus going between courses affects the final time

**9 Holes Specific Rules:** 

You can submit parts of your 18 Holes runs as 9 Holes runs if you want to do so. 

Resort timing starts when 18 Holes timing starts, and ends when the ball goes in or "Give Up" appears in hole 9.

Classic timing starts when the ball goes in the 9th hole, and ends when the ball goes in or "Give Up" appears in hole 18.

Classic runs done in the Classic course, the penalty for Restart timing is 6.27s instead of the usual 3.00s; when starting from the main menu, the penalty is 3.27s

**3 Holes Specific Rules:** 

You cannot take clips from your 18 or 9 Holes runs and submit them to 3 Holes categories. This is because wind works differently in 3 Holes compared to 18/9 Holes courses.

categories.name: All Sports
categories.rules:
**View the "Game Rules" tab above for rules regarding Video, Hardware, and other General Rules.**

**All Sports Objectives:**

To complete a run in this category, you must:

- Win a match of Swordplay: Duel
- Finish a level of Wakeboarding (Any Difficulty)
- Finish a three hole course of Frisbee Golf (Any Course)
- Finish a set of stages in Archery (Any Difficulty)
- Finish a 3-Point Contest in Basketball
- Win a game of Table Tennis: Match
- Finish a three hole course of Golf (Any Course)
- Finish a standard game of Bowling
- Finish a course of Power Cruising (Any Course)
- Finish a level of Canoeing (Any Difficulty)
- Finish a race of Cycling (Any Stage)
- Finish a dive in Air Sports: Skydiving

**Exit Rules:**

You can exit out of the sport you are playing as soon as these requirements are met:

- Swordplay: Duel - You can exit when the feet of the opponent mii are no longer in the ground (as a result of them being knocked out) in the final round
- Wakeboarding - You can exit when the clock reaches 0:00
- Frisbee: Frisbee Golf - You can exit when the goal area disappears in the final hole as a result of the frisbee entering it
- Archery - You can exit when the "Miss" (or any of the point related ones like "+10") text appears after the final shot
- Basketball: 3-Point Contest - You can exit when the final ball leaves your mii's hands
- Table Tennis: Match - You can exit when the "2 Bounces" textbox appears in the final point of the game
- Golf - You can exit when the ball is no longer visible as it enters the final hole
- Bowling: Standard Game -You can exit when the "[X] Pins" text appears after the final throw
- Power Cruising - You can exit when the "Finish" text appears
- Canoeing - You can exit when the yardage counter reaches its goal value (if the goal distance is 100yd, the goal value would be 100.00yd)
- Cycling - You can exit when the Vincenzo text congratulating you for finishing the race appears
- Skydiving - Time ends when the screen flashes white as a result of the final photo being taken

Exiting before any of these conditions are met will result in your run being rejected.

**General Rules:**

Timing begins on the last A press before loading into your first sport (Example: Pressing OK to choose your Mii in Swordplay: Duel or Pressing "Resort A" to enter Frisbee Golf)

Timing ends when the screen flashes white as a result of the final photo being taken after forming up in Skydiving.

You do not need to do any of the sports in a specific order, however you must end with Air Sports: Skydiving.

Set the timer to 3.00 seconds if you decide to restart a sport and start from there. Menu timings rules found in the "Game Rules" section apply

Please make sure that you can clearly see the total in-game time in your video. Runs where it is impossible to confidently see what the final time is will be rejected.

For Co-Op, you can play with 2 players, or 1 players 2 controllers.

games.name: Wii Sports Resort
games.rules:
**Wii Sports Resort General Rules**

Reset timing can be used (starting time from pressing "Restart" instead of the regular start time) with a 3.00 second time penalty. This is the preferred method to start a speedrun.

For some sports, there are time penalties for starting from Main Menu:

- A 1s penalty will be added to runs that start from main menu and with: Duel, Speed Slice, Archery, Pickup Game, Table Tennis - Match, Return Challenge, Bowling, 100-Pin, Spin Control, Canoeing (non-igt speedruns), or Cycling (non-igt speedruns).
- A 1.25s penalty will be added to Swordplay Showdown runs that start from the main menu.
- A 0.75s penalty will be added to Wakeboarding runs that start from the main menu.
- A 1.5s penalty will be added to Skydiving runs that start from the main menu.

Unless explicitly stated otherwise, all runs must be played using only 1 controller by 1 player.

Unless explicitly stated otherwise, all runs are timed with Real Time.

All versions of the game (including the Combo Disc that also includes Wii Sports) are allowed.

**Wii Sports Resort Video Rules**

All runs in every category requires video proof. It must be acceptable video proof. The game feed has to be clearly visible (not obstructed heavily). Heavy amounts of issues with frame rate, bit rate, audio etc. could result in your run being rejected.

Game audio is not required but heavily recommended to further validate your run.

Video proof can be recorded via a Capture Card, Phone Camera, Webcam, etc. as long as they follow the other video guidelines.

Video proof can be uploaded and sent through any site (YouTube, Twitch, Google Drive, etc.), as long as the video is easily accessible.

**Wii Sports Resort Hardware Rules**

You must run on a Wii, Wii Mini, or Wii U console, using an official Wii Sports Resort disc or the Wii Sports + Wii Sports Resort Bundle disc. Doing a speedrun on anything else is not allowed (Emulators, USB Loaders, etc.)

You can only play with a Wii Remote/Wii Remote Plus Controller and a Nunchuk. Third party controllers can be used if they have no added features compared to a traditional Wii Remote. Wii Remote Accessories that have no effect on the controller's functionality can be used as well.
